title: Multi-Class Electrical and Mechanical Fault Classification Using Random Convolutional Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2608.18716v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diagnosing faults in rotating machinery is essential for ensuring the reliability of industrial processes. Random convolutional kernel-based Time Series Classification (TSC) methods, such as ROCKET and its variants, provide an attractive trade-off between predictive performance and computational efficiency. In this work, we evaluate SelF-Rocket for the multi-class diagnosis of both mechanical and electrical faults and introduce, as a new contribution, a multivariate extension of the original method. The proposed approach is compared with leading ROCKET-based methods on two public benchmark datasets, MaFaulDa (mechanical faults) and ITSC-UDG (stator inter-turn short circuits), under both univariate and multivariate settings. translated_title: 基于随机卷积核的多类机电故障分类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18716v1 公告类型：新 摘要：诊断旋转机械中的故障对于确保工业过程的可靠性至关重要。基于随机卷积核的时间序列分类（TSC）方法，如ROCKET及其变体，在预测性能和计算效率之间提供了有吸引力的权衡。在本工作中，我们评估了SelF-Rocket在机械和电气故障的多类诊断中的应用，并作为新贡献，引入了原始方法的多元扩展。所提出的方法与领先的基于ROCKET的方法在两个公开基准数据集上进行了比较，即MaFaulDa（机械故障）和ITSC-UDG（定子匝间短路），在单变量和多变量设置下均进行了评估。实验结果表明，SelF-Rocket在评估方法中实现了最佳的总体准确率-延迟权衡，在MaFaulDa上获得了最高的分类性能，同时保持高度竞争力。
tldr: 本文评估并扩展了SelF-Rocket方法，提出其多元版本，在多类机电故障诊断中实现了最佳的准确率与计算效率权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates and extends SelF-Rocket with a multivariate version, achieving the best accuracy-latency trade-off in multi-class electromechanical fault diagnosis.
